jobs.description:
Relay
is the Intelligent System of Action for the physical economy. While the digital revolution has often left the deskless workforce behind, we are closing that gap by transforming analog frontline operations into a data-rich, AI-powered ecosystem. We aren't just selling radios, we’re building the digital foundation for the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't work at a desk.

Why Join Relay?

A Proven Winner: Join a hyper-growth company trusted by over 10% of the Fortune 500, continuing to move upmarket with massive impact.
High Value, High Impact: With 47% of our revenue from $100K+ ARR customers and 135% Net Revenue Retention (NRR), you'll be joining a company rooted in value creation.
Market-Leading Innovation: The Relay platform captures 1 billion new data points weekly and features award-winning AI tools like TeamTranslate™, with 500% YoY growth.
World-Class Leadership: Our stellar leadership team is built to help us scale toward our next major milestones.
The Relay Culture: We’re dedicated to helping you do the best work of your life (BWIML), investing in your growth through L.I.T., living our CHASE values, and learning from incredibly talented, supportive teammates who make the work (and the wins) better every day.

Now, here’s what we’re building, and where you come in.

Role Overview

The Customer Success Coordinator is a key driver of account health and value realization across our SMB accounts. In this role, you will manage accounts through a defined stage of the customer journey, focusing on site-level adoption, customer engagement, and retention support. Our CSC’s ensures that our customers are consistently leveraging Relay’s core platform features to drive daily operational excellence.

In this position, you will execute across a defined lifecycle stage for a wide array of use cases across various industries. You will learn to interpret health metrics, conduct structured discovery to uncover operational challenges Relay can solve, and build reliable relationships across customer sites. The focus is on maintaining strong account stability, identifying early expansion signals, and helping safeguard our retention targets.

Relay is at a transformative inflection point, moving from a product-centric communications business to a platform-centric AI leader for the frontline. As a CSC I for our SMB accounts, you are the frontline practitioner ensuring this vision translates into real-world value for our clients. You will work within a defined customer journey, blending automation and human involvement, and leverage pattern recognition to suggest process improvements, making you an important contributor to our team's success and the customer experience.

What You'll Do

Retention & Expansion Support: Support net-revenue goals for SMB accounts by driving consistent adoption, safeguarding retention, and flagging site-level expansion opportunities (e.g., user growth, standard feature upsells, and scheduled hardware refreshes).
Value Realization & Book Management: Actively monitor account health across the defined customer lifecycle using standard metrics and usage data. Leveraging status reporting to identify adoption trends, helping customers understand their usage and maximize ROI.
Relationship Building: Establish and maintain reliable, cross-departmental relationships with key operational stakeholders. You will track account updates and organizational changes to maintain a strong rapport and ensure Relay remains embedded in daily operations.
Discovery & Product Credibility: Conduct discovery to identify common site-level operational challenges. Applying a strong foundational knowledge of Relay, you will recommend practical solutions and frame opportunities around clear customer outcomes.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a trusted internal voice for the customer. Partner with Product, Marketing, and Sales to share common customer feedback, and collaborate with Support and Billing to ensure customer escalations are resolved promptly.
Operational Execution: Effectively utilize internal tools and systems to manage day-to-day account activities efficiently. You will flag process or technical friction points and follow established playbooks to ensure a smooth customer experience.

What You'll Have

At least 1 year of experience in a customer-facing or relationship-driven role such as Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Teaching, or Sales Development.
Effective Time Management & Prioritization: You can manage a high volume of accounts in motion without losing track of what needs attention. You triage well and follow through.
Commercial Awareness: You are comfortable discussing contract renewals, identifying expansion signals, and highlighting product value.
Clear Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills. You can organize complex details into easy-to-understand updates and approach challenging conversations with empathy and professionalism.
Genuine Curiosity: Eagerness to learn industry trends and understand the unique needs of your assigned market segments to build trust with customer contacts. Seek to understand the "why" behind the work and actively build on your own expertise.
Technical Aptitude: Ability to quickly learn and navigate an integrated hardware + software platform. You can comfortably explain Relay’s core functional advantages and help users transition from legacy tools.
Comfort with Evolving Tools: Open to and curious about AI-powered tools that support your work. You don't need to be an expert, but you're not resistant to learning new ways of working as the landscape changes.
The "CSC" Mentality: Accountability and adaptability in a high-volume environment. You take feedback well, adjust quickly, and stay focused on the customer even when things are moving fast.

Nice To Have

Experience navigating customer conversations involving renewals, expansion opportunities, pricing, and product value.
Experience owning a book of business and a revenue target
Experience with Hubspot, Attention, Claude, Notion, or other tech foward AI tools

About Relay | Culture, Benefits & Perks

Our culture hinges on Relayers getting LIT
up in an environment that fosters Learning, Impact, and Teamwork, where we CHASE
the best work of our lives. We call this BWIML
(Best Work In My Life).

At Relay, We Offer

100% Paid Insurance: Health, Dental, Vision, Long/Short Term Disability, and Life Insurance for you and your dependents
Generous Paid Time Off
401(k) Savings Plan + Company Match
Baby Cash Reward + Paid Parental Leave
Wellness Perks: If you’re joining our Raleigh-based HQ, you’ll have access to a world-class onsite fitness center with instructor-led classes, plus tennis, basketball, pickleball, and cycling
Team Events & Culture: From company celebrations to team outings, we work hard and have fun doing it.
Latest tech, standing desks, and all the tools and software you need to thrive

The future of frontline work is being built here. Come build it with us. We can’t wait to hear from you.

The Relay Hybrid Work Model

At Relay, relationships are at the core of everything we do - and this translates to how we approach our customers and our work internally. Relay strives to be long-term relational partners versus transactional vendors to our customers. You will be encouraged to get in front of our customers and/or attend a trade show as a Relayer, regardless of your role.

Internally, Relayers endeavor to build authentic, caring, and trusted relationships with each other.

With these principles in mind, and because we believe relationships are formed more quickly and deeply in-person, we greatly value the power of collaborating together with our customers on-site at their properties, and with each other in our spectacular and amenity-rich office.

Our relational approach is also at the heart of why we ask all Relayers in our hybrid model to work from the office a minimum of 3 days per week.

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. Conduct structured discovery to understand customer workflows, pain points, and decision criteria
Identify key value drivers and align solutions to measurable business outcomes
Challenge assumptions and provide a clear, differentiated point of view

Own the solution narrative
Design and deliver tailored product demonstrations that connect directly to customer needs

Drive deal strategy with Sales
Partner with Account Executives to develop deal strategy and influence customer decisions

Build trust and credibility with customers

Provide guidance on best practices, implementation considerations, and future-state workflows
Help customers evaluate tradeoffs and make confident decisions

Ensure alignment on solution scope and expectations for post-sales handoff

This role will be based in our Salt Lake City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. Solutions Consultants at Brex are responsible for leading the consultative, value-driven sales motion. This is not a traditional demo role. SCs act as trusted advisors, helping customers:

Reframe problems and identify opportunities
Evaluate Brex as a strategic solution

You will partner closely with Account Executives to shape deal strategy, guide customer decision-making, and ensure solutions are aligned to real business outcomes, not just product features.

Requirements

3 - 6+ years of experience in Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, or similar customer-facing roles in SaaS
Strong discovery skills with the ability to diagnose business problems, not just respond to requirements
Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Experience presenting to senior stakeholders, including executive-level audiences
Strong collaboration skills and ability to partner effectively with Sales and cross-functional teams
Comfort with ambiguity and ability to create structure in evolving environments
Curiosity and a desire to continuously learn, improve, and refine your approach

The expected OTE range for this role is $137,600 to $172,000. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just getting started, your contributions matter at Fortra. If you’re passionate about tackling meaningful challenges alongside talented team members committed to helping each other succeed, all while having lots of fun, we want to hear from you. We offer competitive benefits and salaries, personal and professional development opportunities, flexibility, and much more!

We are seeking an experienced and consultative Principal Customer Success Manager (CSM) to lead strategic engagements with a portfolio of high-value customers. In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders at all levels, including the C-suite, ensuring customers realize sustained business value from our solutions. You will leverage your deep solution expertise and industry knowledge to identify opportunities, propose tailored strategies, and guide customers toward achieving and expanding their desired outcomes. As a senior leader in customer success, you will proactively manage escalations, foster executive relationships, and champion innovation to support customers’ evolving business needs across the lifecycle.

What You'll Do

Maintains a strong understanding of the company’s solutions and emerging cybersecurity trends to offer valuable insights to customers and protect their interests.
Provides expert guidance on product capabilities, ensuring solutions are customized to fit customer-specific needs and industry requirements.
Prescribes the adoption and use of product features, functionality, and services to help customers achieve their desired outcome goals.
Clearly articulates the return on investment (ROI) and long-term business impact of the company’s solutions to help customers achieve their strategic objectives.
Establishes and manages the customer journey, ensuring each phase—from onboarding to renewal—drives satisfaction, adoption, and retention.
Understands customers' business drivers and success criteria to develop and advise on tailored Customer Success Plans.
Develops strategic recommendations based on comprehensive data insights, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities to improve and enhance customer outcomes, guide and influence decision-making and advance customer success strategies.
Develops and implements tailored action plans based on customer goals, ensuring alignment with both customer objectives and internal business strategies.
Maintains high customer retention and recurring revenue retention rates.
Manages customer satisfaction, ensuring an exceptional customer experience throughout the customer lifecycle.
Creates and maintains referenceable and healthy customers while establishing and maintaining executive-level customer relationships.
Fosters strong relationships across customer organizations, collaborating with stakeholders from frontline teams to executive leadership to align company solutions with customer goals.
Partners with executive-level customers to identify business challenges and develop tailored solutions by promoting Fortra offerings.
Works closely with Sales Engineers and Account Executives to design solutions, create account plans, and identify cross-selling opportunities within Fortra’s portfolio to meet performance and revenue targets.
Ensures customer success by aligning product value with desired business outcomes, fostering long-term partnerships and customer advocacy.
Delivers clear, impactful presentations tailored to various audiences, ensuring complex topics are understood by both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Actively participates in diagnosing and resolving escalated customer concerns, serving as the leadership focal point for communication of outcomes and troubleshooting in critical situations.
Manages complex customer relationships with empathy, engaging customers on a personal level to better understand their needs and provide timely solutions.
Develops and maintains strong relationships with assigned customers, gaining insight into their industry, business, and operations, and serving as a trusted advisor to key influencers and decision-makers.
Prioritizes customer needs and responds swiftly to any potential risks or challenges, ensuring quick resolution of issues to maintain high satisfaction levels.
Ensures accuracy and consistency in all customer deliverables, maintaining high-quality standards in both communication and strategy execution.
Regularly updates CRM and tools with new opportunities, current account details, and other relevant business information.
Identify and nurture upsell opportunities, collaborating with the sales team to drive additional business from existing accounts.
Collect and communicate customer feedback to internal teams, ensuring the company’s solutions continue to evolve in line with customer needs.
Responsible for cross-departmental influence with sales, product, and services teams to ensure successful onboarding, proactive support, and alignment of strategic solutions to add significant business value to align with customer requirements and business outcomes.
Assists CSM team members by sharing best practices and offering guidance to promote high performance within the customer success function. Provides training and mentorship to less experienced CSMs, helping them develop their skills and improve their performance.
Lead special projects aimed at enhancing customer engagement, optimizing processes, or contributing to broader business initiatives.
Take ownership of high-value and strategic customer accounts, working closely with these customers to identify opportunities for growth and maintaining executive-level alignment on goals and value.
Proactively identifies potential churn risks and implements proactive strategies to address them.
Drives actions with cross-functional teams to resolve critical issues and minimize customer attrition.
Responsible for Strategic customers customer risk mitigation and developing and executing risk mitigation plans to ensure long-term customer retention.
Develop, implement, and refine best practices, methods, and processes that enhance the efficiency and scalability of the Customer Success team, driving consistency in outcomes across accounts.
Regularly assess and report on customer health metrics, providing insights on account status, retention risks, and growth opportunities to upper management.
Develops and executes customer success strategies at the organizational level, working closely with C-suite leaders and managers to ensure alignment with business objectives that will drive key company initiatives, increasing revenue, improving operations, or enhancing customer satisfaction.
Schedules and leads regular meeting cadence and executive business reviews with customers, focusing on the customer’s business and key initiatives, providing product and feature updates on Fortra offerings to deliver on the customer key business objectives and create success plans to outline strategies.
Ensure key subject matter experts and other relevant stakeholders are engaged to provide the intimate direction needed for the customer’s strategic discussions.
Continuously refine and improve business analysis processes to enhance efficiency and outcomes.

Innovation

Generates creative, solution-focused ideas that drive improvement and add value.
Challenges conventional thinking, learns from setbacks, and delivers enhanced outcomes.

Accountability

Takes full ownership to deliver assigned tasks, goals, and outcomes.
Delivers high-quality work on time, with clear expectations and proactive communication.

Service Excellence

Anticipates and responds to customer needs with professionalism, ensuring a positive and solutions-oriented experience.
Collaborates across teams, applying feedback to continuously improve service quality and satisfaction.

Teamwork

Works collaboratively with team members to achieve shared goals and support team success.
Values diverse perspectives and fosters an inclusive, respectful, and collaborative team culture.

Qualifications

Minimum length of time in current role: Typically, 10 to 12 years
Related work experience: 15+ years of related experience in strategic account management/customer success management in a technical environment

Our CSC’s ensures that our customers are consistently leveraging Relay’s core platform features to drive daily operational excellence.

In this position, you will execute across a defined lifecycle stage for a wide array of use cases across various industries. You will learn to interpret health metrics, conduct structured discovery to uncover operational challenges Relay can solve, and build reliable relationships across customer sites. The focus is on maintaining strong account stability, identifying early expansion signals, and helping safeguard our retention targets.

Relay is at a transformative inflection point, moving from a product-centric communications business to a platform-centric AI leader for the frontline. As a CSC I for our SMB accounts, you are the frontline practitioner ensuring this vision translates into real-world value for our clients. You will work within a defined customer journey, blending automation and human involvement, and leverage pattern recognition to suggest process improvements, making you an important contributor to our team's success and the customer experience.

What You'll Do

Retention & Expansion Support: Support net-revenue goals for SMB accounts by driving consistent adoption, safeguarding retention, and flagging site-level expansion opportunities (e.g., user growth, standard feature upsells, and scheduled hardware refreshes).
Value Realization & Book Management: Actively monitor account health across the defined customer lifecycle using standard metrics and usage data. Leveraging status reporting to identify adoption trends, helping customers understand their usage and maximize ROI.
Relationship Building: Establish and maintain reliable, cross-departmental relationships with key operational stakeholders. You will track account updates and organizational changes to maintain a strong rapport and ensure Relay remains embedded in daily operations.

Experience owning a book of business and a revenue target
Experience with Hubspot, Attention, Claude, Notion, or other tech foward AI tools
